(police du calque): The style keeps the text layer's font.
+ Ajouter un filtre: Adds a non-destructive filter to the layer.
+ Ajouter une action: Adds one of your actions or a built-in action to the chain run on each image.
+ Ajouter une étape: Adds a new step at the end of the action: pick the command from the list.
+ Commentaire ici: Adds a comment frame where you clicked.
+ Cube: Adds a cube to the render scene.
+ Filtre: Adds a non-destructive filter to the 3D layer, on one channel or all of them.
+ Filtre gradué: Adds a graduated filter: adjustments limited to a gradient area (sky, foreground).
+ Filtre radial: Adds a radial filter: adjustments limited to an ellipse (face, subject).
+ Fond: Adds a curved studio backdrop (floor and wall with no visible seam).
+ Modèle du projet: Adds a copy of the painted model, with its textures, to the render scene.
Imports a 3D model (OBJ, FBX, glTF, uasset or .sx3d project) into the render scene.
+ Nouvelle: Creates a new empty action in your actions.
+ Plan: Adds a horizontal plane to use as a floor.
+ Sphère: Adds a sphere to the render scene.
+ Trim: Adds a new trim to the list.
+ Variable: Creates a new graph variable that Get and Set nodes can read and write.
+ premier plan: Adds the foreground color to the sampled colors (up to 8).
+ élément: Adds an item at the end of the array, initialized with the last item's value.
Exports to PSD or PSB with 16 bits per channel (smoother gradients).
4 vues: Shows the histogram, waveform, vectorscope and spectrum together.
Exports to PSD or PSB with 8 bits per channel (most compatible).
90° antihoraire: Rotates the whole image a quarter turn counterclockwise.
90° horaire: Rotates the whole image a quarter turn clockwise.
< Disposition: Returns to the plane layout; the current warp is discarded.
< Retour: Returns to the parent document containing this function.
A4 300 ppp: A4 portrait page at 300 ppi (2480 x 3508 px).
A4 paysage: A4 landscape page at 300 ppi (3508 x 2480 px).
Abandonner l'aperçu: Discards the computed unwrap and keeps the current UVs.
Aberration chromatique: Offsets the color channels toward the image edges, like a real lens.
Aberrations chromatiques: Corrects lateral color fringing on high-contrast edges.
Actif: Turns this filter on or off without deleting it.
Actions: Actions panel: record a sequence of operations, then replay it on an image in one click.
Activer les corrections de profil (lensf: Corrects distortion, chromatic aberration and vignetting from the lens's lensfun profile.
Activé: Turns the mask on or off without deleting it.
Activé par défaut: Initial value of this boolean parameter: checked when the effect is applied.
Adapter à l'écran: Zooms so the whole image fits in the window (Ctrl+0).
Adhérence: How strongly particles stick to the surface instead of leaving it.
Affichage: View menu: zoom, view mode, proofing, rulers, guides, grid and snapping.
Afficher: Shows the inpainting mask as an overlay on the canvas.
Afficher dans l'Explorateur Windows: Opens the file's folder in File Explorer with the file selected.
Afficher le maillage: Shows the warp mesh over the image.
Afficher sur le canevas: Draws the trim rectangles and names over the image.
Agrandir: Opens the node's code in a large window.
Agrandir (px): Grows the result layer's mask by this many pixels so the retouch fully covers the area.
Agrandir les petites images: Also enlarges images smaller than the maximum size; otherwise they are left unchanged.
Aide: Help menu: documentation, getting started, updates and information about Shaderixel.
Ajouter au graphe (nœud image): Adds an image node that loads this file into the graph.
Adds every image in the folder of the chosen image.
Ajouter un commentaire (C): Adds a comment frame to annotate and group nodes (shortcut C).
Adds an image to the list of images to merge.
Ajouter un masque de fusion: Adds a mask to the layer, made from the selection if there is one.
Ajouter un plan à droite: Adds a plane attached to the right edge of the selected plane.
Ajouter à la scène de rendu: Imports this model as an extra object in the render scene.
Ajuster aux nœuds contenus: Resizes the comment to fit exactly around the nodes it contains.
Alignement: Text line alignment: left, centered or right.
Automatically aligns the chosen layers based on their shared content.
Aligner: Aligns the chosen items on their edges or centers.
Aligner sur des blocs 4x4: Aligns islands to 4x4 texel blocks, suited to texture compression (BC/DXT).
Aligné: The source follows the brush from stroke to stroke; unchecked, each stroke restarts from the original source.
Analyse d'image: Image Analysis: histogram, waveform, vectorscope, spectrum, statistics, dominant colors and comparison.
Analyse d'image|Comparer: Compares the image with another layer: differences and error measurements.
Analyse sur le canevas: Overlays an exposure or focus aid on the canvas: zebras, clipping, false color, focus peaking.
Angle (°): Image rotation angle in degrees; positive is clockwise.
Angle aléatoire: Random angle variation of each dab.
Angle des axes: Rotates the symmetry axes around the center, in degrees.
Animation: Frame animation: each frame stores the state of the layers and its duration; GIF or video export.
Annuler (Échap): Abandons the current operation without changing anything (Esc).
Aperçu 3D: Shows the trim sheet applied to a model in the 3D view.
Aperçu du calque: Shows the content of the active layer, its mask or the selected node on its own.
Aperçu du calque|Calque: Shows the layer contents in the preview.
Aperçus sur les nœuds: Shows a small result thumbnail on each node.
Aplatir chaque page: Flattens each page into a single layer instead of one layer per image.
Aplatir l'image: Merges all layers into a single background layer.
Apparence (opacité, fusion, filtres): The comp stores and restores layer opacity, blend mode and filters.
Appliquer (Ctrl+Entrée): Compiles the brush code and uses it (Ctrl+Enter).
Appliquer aux pixels (destructif): Applies the effect directly to the layer pixels: it can no longer be edited afterwards.
Appliquer le profil: Applies the selected lens profile corrections with the settings above.
Appliquer le préréglage: Applies the chosen preset using the selected mode: whole scene, lighting only, or adding its objects.
Appliquer une image: Blends a channel of a layer or document into the active layer using a blend mode.
Blends a layer or channel from an open image into the active layer with a blend mode.
Appliquer une image|Calque: Source layer to apply; "Merged" uses the whole image.
Appliquer une image|Couche: Channel of the source applied to the active layer.
Appliquer une image|Inverser: Inverts the source channel (negative) before blending.
Appliquer une image|Mode: Blend mode used to combine the source with the active layer.
Appliquer une image|Opacité: Strength with which the source is blended onto the active layer.
Approche: Uniform spacing between characters, in thousandths of an em.
Arrière-plan: Contents of the starting layer: white, transparent, black, or no layer.
Arrêter: Stops the turntable render in progress.
Assistant IA: AI Assistant: MCP bridge to drive Shaderixel from an AI agent, and chat with an assistant.
Assistant IA|Copier: Copies the MCP configuration to paste into your AI client.
Assistant IA|Modèle: Name of the model used by the assistant connector; empty: the connector's default model.
Changes the document's color profile without touching pixels: the appearance changes.
Aucun: No environment: only the lights illuminate the scene, over the background color.
Auto: History memory limit chosen automatically from the graphics card and system memory.
Automatisation: Actions, batch processing, panoramas, HDR merge, contact sheet and other automated tasks.
Avant (P): Shows the photo before adjustments for comparison (shortcut P).
Avant / après: Compares the image with a snapshot taken before the edits.
Balance auto: Automatically computes the white balance from the photo content.
Bas: Also trims the bottom edge of the image.
Bibliothèque: Picks an image from the textures shipped with the brushes.
Bords: Edge handling after rotation: keep the size, crop out empty corners, or enlarge to keep everything.
Bords droits: Favors islands with straight edges, easier to pack.
C++ : DLL (commande, fenêtre, outil): C++ plugin built as a DLL that can add commands, windows or tools.
CMJN du document: Uses the document's CMYK profile as the proof profile.
Cage : au-dessus: Search distance above the low-poly surface when looking for the high-poly mesh, as a percentage of the model size.
Calcul: Renders on the graphics card (fast) or on the CPU.
Calculer l'aperçu: Runs the unwrap with these settings; the result is shown before it is applied.
Calculs: Combines channels from documents (red, green, blue, alpha...) with a blend mode into a selection, layer or document.
Combines two channels from open images with a blend mode to create a new channel, selection or document.
Calculs|Calque: Layer for this source; "Merged" uses the whole image.
Calculs|Couche: Channel of this source used in the calculation.
Calculs|Inverser: Inverts this source channel (negative) before the calculation.
Calculs|Mode: Blend mode used to combine the two sources.
Calculs|Opacité: Strength with which the second source is blended onto the first.
Calque: Layer menu: create, duplicate, merge, group and align layers and manage their masks.
Calque suivi: 3D layer whose paint drives this mask (on top, at the edge, around or elsewhere).
Calques: The document's layer stack: order, visibility, blend mode, opacity, masks and groups.
Calques 3D: Layers of the Paint 3D project: paint, materials, smart materials and folders, with their masks and filters.
Calques 3D|Direction: Axis of the smart mask gradient (up, down, X or Z).
Calques 3D|Dégrouper: Removes the folder and keeps its layers in its place.
Calques 3D|Effacer: Clears the paint from the targeted channels of the selected 3D layer.
Calques 3D|Inverser: Inverts the smart mask: the material goes where it did not.
Calques 3D|Peindre le masque: Selects the material mask for painting on the model: white applies the material, black removes it.
Calques 3D|Supprimer: Deletes the selected 3D layer or folder.
Caméra: Render camera projection, field of view, depth of field and distance.
Canevas: Work area where the document is displayed and painted.
Capitales: Displays text in this style in all capitals.
Carré: Crops to a centered square; otherwise to the given width and height.
Catégorie: Category the item is filed under in the library.
Centre: Center point in pixels: the brush symmetry center or the transform's rotation pivot.
Centre du document: Moves the symmetry center back to the middle of the document.
Champ de vision: Vertical angle seen by the camera: small = telephoto, large = wide angle.
Loads a 3D lookup table (.cube LUT) to grade the colors.
Opens a .sxscene file and applies it using the selected mode.
Loads a Photoshop (.aco, .ase) or GIMP (.gpl) swatch file.
Checkpoint: Model file (checkpoint) loaded by ComfyUI for the built-in graph.
Choisir sur le modèle: Then click on the model to focus on that point.
Picks an XML file of the lensfun database; its folder becomes the lens profile source.
Ciel: Automatically selects the sky in the photo using the segmentation model.
Clair = lisse: Bright areas of the image become smooth and glossy; when off, they become rough.
Coché par défaut: Initial state of this parameter's check box.
Coller: Pastes the clipboard contents (Ctrl+V), or the copied settings.
Coller en perspective: Places the pasted image on a perspective plane (wall, floor, screen) by dragging its four corners.
Coller en perspective (calque actif): Pastes the clipboard onto a perspective plane: place the four corners on the target surface.
Coller en perspective|Opacité: Opacity of the image pasted onto the perspective plane.
Colonne d'aperçu: Shows the result preview column next to the graph.
Colonnes: Number of images per row on each page.
Commentaire: Free note attached to this comp.
Commentaire autour de la sélection: Wraps the selected nodes in a comment frame (C).
Comparer: Turns comparison with the "before" snapshot on or off.
Comparer avec: Layer compared with the current image.
Compiler (Ctrl+Entrée): Compiles the code and updates the result; errors are marked in red (Ctrl+Enter).
Compositions de calques: Stores layer visibility, appearance and position states to switch between variants of the document.
Compositions de calques|Mettre à jour: Overwrites the selected comp with the current state of the layers.
Confirmer la suppression: Permanently deletes this template, its thumbnail and its description.
Conserver la transparence: Applies the image only where the target layer already has opaque pixels; transparent areas stay empty.
Conserver les proportions: Keeps the width-to-height ratio: changing one dimension adjusts the other.
Conserver les îlots existants: Keeps the current UV islands and only repacks them.
Contenu: What gets exported: the whole image, the selection rectangle or each layer separately.
Contour: Strokes the active path with the current brush on the active layer.
Contour (arrière-plan): Strokes the shape's edge with the background color.
Contour progressif: Softens the selection edge over the given distance, in pixels.
Softens the selection edge over a radius in pixels (Shift+F6).
Strokes the selection outline with the foreground color.
Contracts the selection by a number of pixels.
Contraste: Difference between light and dark tones in the rendered image.
Convertir cet effet en graphe vide: Replaces this effect with a starter graph to build with nodes.
Convertir en HLSL éditable: Replaces the graph with its HLSL code for hand editing.
Convertir en calques: Converts the node document into a regular layer stack, when the graph allows it.
Convertir en image: Replaces the node with an image holding its pixel result; upstream nodes are no longer needed.
Convertir en mode calques: Converts the node graph back into a layer stack, when its structure allows it.
Convertir en mode nodal: Converts the document into a node graph for advanced compositing.
Convertir en objet dynamique: Turns the active layer into a smart object that can be transformed without quality loss.
Converts pixels to another color profile while keeping their appearance.
Copier: Copies to the clipboard: the contents of the active layer's selection (Ctrl+C), or the settings shown.
Copier dans mes actions: Copies this built-in action into your actions so you can edit it.
Couche: Color channel used: RGB, red, green, blue or alpha.
Couleur: Picks the color: click the swatch to open the color picker (wheel, RGB, HSV or hex values).
Couleur de l'arrêt: Color of the selected stop: a chosen color, or the foreground or background color.
Couleur du pixel en bas à droite: Trims borders matching the color of the bottom-right pixel.
Couleur du pixel en haut à gauche: Trims borders matching the color of the top-left pixel.
Couleur fixe: Fills with the color chosen here; unchecked, uses the foreground color at run time.
Couleurs Lab: Switches the document to Lab color mode (lightness separate from color).
Couleurs RVB: Switches the document to RGB color mode.
Couleurs d'épreuve: Displays the document as it will be reproduced with the proof profile (Ctrl+Alt+Y).
Couleurs dominantes: Palette of the image's main colors; click: foreground, Shift+click: background.
Couper: Copies the active layer's selection to the clipboard, then clears it (Ctrl+X).
Courbe: Tone-mapping curve that brings highlights into the displayable range (ACES, AgX, PBR Neutral...).
Courbure: Bakes a curvature map: sharp edges bright, cavities dark; used by smart masks for edge wear.
Coutures (UV): Weight of existing UV seams: higher makes new cuts follow them.
Creux: Depth of the dips between star points: low gives thin points, high an almost round star.
Créer l'animation: Creates the first animation frame from the current state of the layers.
Créer les bandes: Replaces the trims with the strips defined in Heights.
Créer les canaux PBR: Adds roughness, metallic, normal and other channels to paint a full PBR material.
Créer les deux calques: Creates the low- and high-frequency layers from the active layer.
Créer un outil depuis la sélection: Turns the selected nodes into a custom tool with its own graph.
Créer un pinceau en graphe: Replaces the active brush with a node-based brush to edit here.
Creates a starter plugin (Python or C++) in your plugin folder.
Créer un sous-graphe depuis la sélection: Collapses the selected nodes into a reusable function node.
Créer un tracé depuis la sélection: Converts the selection outline into an editable vector path.
Créer une fusion en code: Gives the active layer a blend mode written in HLSL, from a template.
Créer une fusion en graphe: Gives the active layer a node-based blend mode to edit here.
Cube: Creates the project on a cube.
Cuire: Starts baking the checked maps with these settings.
Cuisson des cartes (baker): Bakes mesh maps (normal, occlusion, curvature, thickness, height, ID...) into the model's UVs, from the model itself or a high-poly mesh.
Bakes the model maps (normal, occlusion, curvature, thickness...) for smart masks.
Cuisson des cartes (baker)|Hauteur: Bakes a height map: the offset between the high-poly and low-poly surfaces.
Cuisson des cartes (baker)|Position: Bakes a position map: the 3D coordinates of each texel, useful for spatial gradients and masks.
Cuisson des cartes (baker)|Résolution: Size of the baked maps, in pixels.
Cuisson des cartes (baker)|Épaisseur: Bakes a thickness map: thin parts of the model are bright (useful for subsurface scattering).
Côté (px): Side of the square in pixels; 0 uses the shortest side of the image.
Côtés: Number of sides of the polygon or points of the star.
Côtés / branches: Number of polygon sides or star points.
De l'autre côté: Puts the text on the other side of the path, running the other way.
Denoise: Regeneration strength: 1 generates the image entirely, lower keeps more of the input image.
Densité: Number of points in the warp mesh: more points follow the pins more closely but compute more slowly.
Depuis la sélection: Adds the current selection to the inpainting mask.
Depuis le tracé actif: Saves the active path as a reusable custom shape.
Creates a document from a preset or saved template.
Descendre: Moves the step down one place in the action.
Description: Short description shown with the preset.
Différence: Shows the difference between the "before" snapshot and the current image.
Expands the selection by a number of pixels.
Disposition: Panorama projection: automatic, perspective, cylindrical or reposition only.
Dispositions: Loads, saves or deletes panel arrangements.
Dissocier: Removes the selected group while keeping its layers (Ctrl+Shift+G).
Distance: Distance from the camera to its target point.
Distance (m): Focus distance, in meters; some profiles use it for distortion correction.
Distance nette: Distance at which the image is in focus with depth of field.
Distorsion: Corrects the lens's geometric distortion (barrel or pincushion).
Distorsion horizontale: Horizontal perspective effect: the text grows on one side and shrinks on the other.
Distorsion verticale: Vertical perspective effect: the text grows at the top or at the bottom.
Document: Document the source channel is read from (among documents of the same size).
Document vide: Creates a blank document with the chosen size, precision and background.
Documents ouverts: Adds the files of the currently open documents to the list.
Dossier: Processes the images of a source folder.
Double face: Renders both sides of polygons in Unreal (foliage, cloth, thin planes).
Douceur du vignettage: How gradually the center fades into the darkened corners.
Droite: Also trims the right edge of the image.
Dupliquer: Creates a copy of the item right after the original.
Dupliquer l'image: Adds a new frame copied from the selected frame.
Dupliquer le calque: Creates a copy of the active layer just above it (Ctrl+J).
Dureté: Brush edge sharpness: 0 very soft edge, 1 hard edge.
Durée de vie: How long each particle lives, in seconds, before it stops painting.
Débit: Amount of paint laid down by each dab of the mixer brush.
Débruitage: Smooths path-tracing noise while keeping edges; 0 = off.
Décalage de ligne de base: Raises or lowers characters relative to the line, in pixels (superscript, subscript).
Décaler le contour: Moves the edge inward (negative) or outward (positive).
Définir un motif: Saves the selection (or image) as a reusable pattern for fills and the pattern stamp.
Déformation: Warps the layer with a grid of control points.
Déformation de la perspective: Changes the layer's perspective by moving the corners of planes drawn on the image.
Déformer >: Finishes the plane layout and moves on to warping: drag the corners to change the perspective.
Délier les calques: Unlinks the chosen layers: they move separately again.
Démarrer: Starts batch processing with the chosen actions and settings.
Désactiver (bypass): The node passes its input through unchanged without being deleted.
Désactivé (bypass): The node passes its input through unchanged.
Détacher du tracé: Detaches the text from the path so it becomes normal text again.
Effacer: Clears the selection (or layer) contents to transparency (Delete).
Effacer la liste: Clears the list of recent files.
Effacer la zone d'essai: Clears the strokes painted in the brush test pad.
Effacer le résultat: Discards the result kept by this node: upstream nodes are computed again.
Effacer les repères: Removes all guides from the document.
Effacer les retouches: Clears the corrections painted over the smart mask.
Effacer les résultats: Clears the results kept from running this function.
Effets: Library of effects and filters with previews: apply them as adjustment layers, nodes or directly to pixels.
Effets de caméra: Turns on post-processing effects: bloom, sharpening, aberration, color, vignette, grain.
Picks the image used for effect previews.
Empiler les images (mise au point): Keeps the sharpest area of each image for an extended depth of field.
Enregistrer: Saves the active document to its file (Ctrl+S), or what was entered in this window.
Enregistrer comme action: Saves these Photo RAW settings as an action you can replay on other images.
Saves the whole document as a starting template for new documents.
Enregistrer comme modèle|Catégorie: Category the template appears under in the New Document window.
Enregistrer comme modèle|Enregistrer: Saves the document as a reusable template for new documents.
Enregistrer comme préréglage: Adds the current scene to your presets, reusable in every project.
Enregistrer dans la bibliothèque: Saves this function to the library to reuse it in other graphs.
Saves this item to the library under a name and category, to reuse it in other projects.
Saves the current panel arrangement under a name.
Enregistrer la disposition|Enregistrer: Saves the current panel arrangement under this name.
Saves the document to a new file (Ctrl+Shift+S).
Saves the current settings as a new Photo RAW preset.
Entrer dans le dossier au-dessus: Moves the selected layer into the folder just above it.
Entrée: Index of the input image this node reads.
Entrées: Number of input images the effect receives (0 for a generator).
Environnement (HDRI): Environment image that lights the scene and can be shown as the background.
Envoyer: Sends the message to the assistant (Ctrl+Enter).
Envoyer l'image actuelle comme référence: Attaches the active document image to the request to guide generation.
Erreurs de shaders: Window listing the shaders that failed to compile, with their error messages.
Espace avant: Space added above each paragraph, in pixels.
Espacement: Distance between brush dabs along the stroke, as a fraction of the diameter.
Espacement (px): Space between images in the grid, in pixels.
Exemple: Fills the box with an annotated HLSL effect example.
Exemples: Opens one of the example documents shipped with Shaderixel (2D and 3D).
Exports the animation as an animated GIF.
Exporter en PNG: Also saves each baked map as a PNG file in the given folder.
Exporter en PSD (calques): Exports the document as a Photoshop file with its layers, in 8 or 16 bits per channel.
Exports the image converted to CMYK as a TIFF file for print.
Saves the image (final output or node result) to a PNG, JPEG, TIFF, TGA or BMP file.
Saves the trim rectangles to a JSON file for your modeling tools.
Exports each layer comp to its own image file.
Exports one image per comp, named after the comp (PNG or JPEG).
Exports each artboard to its own PNG or JPEG file.
Exporter les textures: Exports the model's PBR maps (color, normal, ORM...) using an engine preset.
Exports the project's PBR textures using an engine preset (Unreal, Unity...).
Exporter les textures|Format: File type and bit depth of the exported textures: 8- or 16-bit PNG, or 8-bit TGA.
Exporter les textures|Modèle: Export preset: maps produced, their channel packing and naming for the target engine.
Exporter les textures|Taille: Size of the exported textures: the document size, a fraction of it, or a fixed size.
Exporter pour Unreal: Exports the model, its textures and a material instance ready to import into Unreal Engine.
Exporter pour Unreal (modèle + matériau): Exports the model, textures and a material description ready to import into Unreal.
Chooses the folder and writes the model, textures and material description (.sxmat.json) for Unreal.
Exporter sous: Exports the image or each layer in a chosen format, at one or more sizes.
Chooses the destination file and exports with the settings above.
Exporter sous|Fond: Color that replaces transparency in the exported file.
Exporter sous|Format: Format of the exported file: PNG, JPEG, 16-bit TIFF, TGA or BMP.
Exports the animation as an MP4 video.
Exports the flattened image to a PNG, JPEG, 16-bit TIFF, TGA or BMP file (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+W).
Exposition: Brightens or darkens the image, in exposure stops (EV).
Exposée (réglable sur le nœud de la fonc: Shows the variable as a parameter of the function node, adjustable from the parent graph.
Extensions: File extensions to process, separated by spaces (e.g. png jpg); empty: all images.
Exécuter: Runs the selected action on the active document.
Exécuter cette étape: Runs only this step on the active document.
Exécuter jusqu'ici: Runs the action from the first step up to and including this one.
Exécuter sur l'image: Runs all the steps of the action on the active document.
Exécuter à partir d'ici: Runs the action from this step to the end.
Fausses couleurs: False color: each exposure range is colored to spot clipped highlights and crushed shadows.
Faux gras: Thickens characters artificially when the font has no bold weight.
Favoris: Shows only effects marked as favorites.
Fenêtre: Panels, extra windows and interface layouts.
Fenêtres: Shows or hides windows added by plugins.
Fichier: File menu: create, open, save, import and export documents.
Loads an HDR environment image (or PNG, JPG, EXR) to light the model.
Figer (Entrée): Stops the flow and keeps the paint as it is now (Enter).
Filtre: Filter menu: adds a filter to the active layer or applies it directly to the pixels.
Filtre HLSL personnalisé: Adds a filter whose HLSL code you write, starting from a template.
Flux: Amount of paint laid down by each brush dab; dabs build up along the stroke.
Focale (mm): Focal length used for the photo, in millimeters; profile corrections depend on it.
Fond (premier plan): Fills the shape with the foreground color.
Fondu des bords: Width of the blend between the repaired area and its surroundings.
Fondu du raccord: Width of the blend used by Make seamless, as a fraction of the trim's width.
Force: Strength of the gravity that makes the paint run.
Fournisseur: AI service that generates the image: OpenAI, Google Gemini or local ComfyUI.
Fréquence des points: Distance in pixels after which the magnetic lasso automatically places an anchor point.
Merges several exposures of the same scene into an HDR image.
Blends the aligned layers, keeping the sharpest areas (focus stacking) or as a panorama.
Fusion du calque: Edits the active layer's custom blend mode.
Fusionner les calques visibles: Merges all visible layers into a single layer (Ctrl+Shift+E).
Fusionner les images (masques de fondu): Creates masks that blend the images together instead of simply overlapping them.
Fusionner vers le bas: Merges the active layer with the layer just below it (Ctrl+E).
Fusionné: Uses the whole source image, with all visible layers merged.
Fusions: Layer blend modes: pick one for the active layer, or create your own in code or as a graph.
Fusions d'effets: Blend modes from the effect library (imported or custom blends).
Shows the Effects panel to browse and apply filters.
Gauche: Also trims the left edge of the image.
Lists installed plugins and lets you install, create or open their folder.
Gouttes qui tombent: On a downward-facing surface, thick paint breaks off into drops.
Grain: Adds film grain to the image.
Graphe: The document's node editor: nodes, links, comments and functions.
Graphe d'effet: Shows the nodes available in the effect editor (a filter's code or graph).
Graphe des calques: Shows the nodes available in the document's layer graph.
Gravité: Force pulling particles downward: higher values make them run faster.
Grille: Shows or hides the grid on the canvas (Ctrl+').
Grouper: Puts the chosen layers into a new group (Ctrl+G).
Génération IA: AI Generation: creates an image from a text prompt with OpenAI, Gemini or ComfyUI.
Génération IA|Force: How much the starting image is changed: low stays close, 1 recreates it entirely.
Génération IA|Format: Size and orientation of the generated image: square, landscape or portrait.
Génération IA|Modèle: Name of the image model requested from the provider.
Haut: Also trims the top edge of the image.
Hauteur dans le canal Hauteur: Also puts the baked height map into the project's Height channel.
Histogramme: Histogram: distribution of pixels by level, from shadows (left) to highlights (right).
Histogramme|Couche: Channel shown by the histogram: colors, luminosity, red, green or blue.
Historique: History of the document's operations: click a step to go back to it; snapshots and memory settings.
Historique|Ouverture: State of the document when it was opened: click to undo every operation.
Humide: Wet preset: the brush color mixes with the canvas.
ID couleur: Bakes an ID map: a flat color per material, object or UV island, for quick area selection.
Image: Image and canvas size, rotation, cropping, color mode and image calculations.
Image finale: Shows the complete result of all layers (Ctrl+Alt+1).
Image suivante aussi: Also shows the next frame as an onion skin, in addition to the previous one.
Picks an image file from disk (PNG, JPG, TGA, BMP).
Images: Number of frames for one full turn of the model.
Images / s: Video frame rate; together with the frame count it sets the turn's duration.
Images PNG: Also saves every frame as a numbered PNG next to the video.
Images à ajouter: Number of in-between frames inserted between the two frames.
Places an image as a smart object embedded in the document.
Places an image as a smart object linked to its file, updated when the file changes.
Places a file as an embedded smart object: a copy is kept in the document and can be transformed losslessly.
Places a file as a linked smart object: it updates when the original file changes.
Imports the patterns of a Photoshop .pat file.
Adds an image as a new layer in the active document (Ctrl+Shift+O).
Importer des ressources: Imports brushes, patterns or swatches in Photoshop or GIMP formats.
Pastes or opens HLSL to create an effect with its inputs and outputs.
Imports the paths of an SVG file as a custom shape.
Creates an effect from an annotated HLSL file and adds it to the document.
Loads actions from a file and adds them to your actions.
Incliné 45°: Surface tilted at 45°: the paint runs more slowly.
Inclure la balance des blancs et l'expos: The preset also stores temperature, tint and exposure (often specific to each photo).
Inclure les sous-dossiers: Also includes the images in subfolders of the chosen folder.
Incorporer: Copies the linked file into the document so the object no longer depends on the original file.
Indice (IOR): Index of refraction of the transparent material: 1.33 water, 1.5 glass, 2.4 diamond.
Inflexion: Amount of bend of the text warp, up or down.
Inpainting IA: AI Inpainting: paint a mask over an area, describe what you want and the AI recreates it in a new layer.
Inpainting IA|Inverser: Inverts the inpainting mask: the area to recreate becomes the rest of the image.
Inpainting IA|Peindre le masque: The brush paints the area for the AI to recreate; the eraser shrinks it.
Installs the rembg segmentation model (Python) used by Subject and Sky.
Intensité émission: Strength of the light emitted by the surface; above 1 the object lights up the scene.
Intensité émissive: Emission multiplier in the Unreal material (EmissiveStrength parameter).
Interligne: Spacing between lines, as a multiple of the text size.
Interpolation: Resampling method for transformed pixels: nearest (crisp), bilinear or bicubic (smooth).
Interpoler les images: Inserts the in-between frames between the selected frame and the next one.
Intervertir: Inverts the selection: selected areas become unselected and vice versa (Ctrl+Shift+I).
Inverser: Inverts the result: what was included is excluded and vice versa.
Inverser (sélectionner le flou): Selects the blurry areas (background) instead of the sharp ones.
Inverser la rampe: Reverses the ramp: the start becomes the end.
Irrégularité: Random flow variations for less uniform drips.
Jusqu'au calque sélectionné: Shows the image composited up to the selected layer, without the layers above (Ctrl+Alt+3).
Lancer: Starts rendering the turn to the chosen files.
Libellé: Texture name shown in the brush settings.
Libre (sans grille): Turns snapping off: the value changes freely, without a fixed step.
Lignes: Number of image rows per page; extra images go on new pages.
Lissage (anti-crénelage): Smooths the jagged edges of the selection.
Log: Logarithmic histogram scale: small counts become visible.
Luminance: Brightens or darkens each color range separately.
Lumières: Render scene lights: add, select and adjust each light source.
Magnétisme: Snaps moves and drawing to guides, grid and edges (Ctrl+Shift+;).
Marionnette: Deforms the layer by moving pins placed on the image, like a puppet.
Masque: Shows the layer mask instead of its content.
Masque : tout: Fills the mask with white: the material covers the whole model.
Masque d'écrêtage: Clips the layer to the shape of the layer below (Ctrl+Alt+G).
Masquer la zone graphe: Collapses the bottom graph area to enlarge the canvas (Tab).
Matériau du pinceau: Values painted into each PBR channel and settings of the 3D tools: brush, fill, simulation, projection.
Picks the decal image to project onto the model.
Matériau du pinceau|Dispersion: Spread of the particles around their path.
Matériau du pinceau|Inverser: Inverts the stencil: paint goes through where the image blocked it.
Matériau du pinceau|Opacité: Opacity of the decal projected onto the model.
Matériau du pinceau|Orientation: Horizontal direction of the custom gravity, in degrees.
Matériau du pinceau|Préréglage: Loads a predefined material (metal, plastic, wood...) into the values painted by the 3D brush.
Matériau du pinceau|Rotation: Angle of the projected decal, in degrees.
Matériau du pinceau|Taille: Size of the brush or of the decal projected onto the model.
Adds a material whose color is a tiling image projected onto the model.
Matériau projeté (motif): Adds a material whose color is a library pattern projected onto the model.
Matériaux: Materials of the 3D texture: each has its own PBR channel values and a paintable mask.
Matériaux|Peindre le masque: Selects the material mask for painting: white applies the material, black removes it.
Max: Maximum value of this parameter's slider in Properties.
Mettre en forme: Reformats the code: one statement per line, indented blocks.
Mettre à jour les objets liés: Reloads every linked smart object from its file.
Min: Minimum value of this parameter's slider in Properties.
Min / max: Slider range of this input in Properties.
Mise au point: Distance at which the image is sharp when the aperture adds blur.
Mise au point sur le modèle: Sets the focus distance to the model the camera is aiming at.
Resizes the image by removing or adding low-importance pixels, without distorting the main subjects.
Mode: Color mode of the document: RGB, CMYK, grayscale...
Mode Apply (sinon Live): Checked: the function's outputs are frozen as pixels on each Apply; otherwise recomputed live.
Mode Masque: Shows the selection as a red overlay you can paint with brushes (Q).
Mode de rendu: How out-of-gamut colors are converted: perceptual, relative colorimetric, saturation or absolute colorimetric.
Mode de vue: What the canvas shows: the final image, the selected layer alone or the image up to that layer.
Mode masque (Q): Shows the selection as a red overlay you can paint on (Q).
Modifier: Feather, expand or contract the selection edge.
Modifier (double-clic): Opens the function's inner graph for editing (same as double-clicking the node).
Modifier la fonction: Opens the function's inner graph for editing (double-click the node).
Modifier le contenu: Opens the smart object's contents in a tab; save it to update the layer.
Modifier une copie (code): Creates an editable copy of this item's code; the library stays untouched.
Modifier une copie (graphe): Creates an editable copy of this item's graph; the library stays untouched.
Modèle d'export: How textures are written on export: separate, or packed for Unreal (ORM) or Unity HDRP (MaskMap).
Modèles: Ready-made document templates, sorted by category.
Moitié + entière: Exports at half and full size.
Monter: Moves the step up one place in the action.
Mosaïque (répéter sur le plan): Tiles the pasted image across the whole plane.
Motif: Pattern painted by the pattern stamp, chosen from the Patterns panel.
Picks a pattern from the Patterns panel as the projected image.
Motifs: Repeatable patterns: fill the selection, create them from the image or import Photoshop .pat files.
Imports the patterns of a Photoshop .pat file.
Motifs|Échelle: Pattern size when it fills the selection or layer.
Mur: Vertical surface: the paint runs downward.
Mélange seul: No-load preset: the brush only blends the existing colors.
Métal: 0 = non-metal (plastic, wood), 1 = metal: reflections take on the base color.
Méthode: Upscale method: fast bicubic on the GPU or an AI model through ComfyUI.
Navigateur: Thumbnail of the image with the view frame: drag the frame to pan, use the zoom controls below.
Ne pas enregistrer: Closes the document without saving the changes.
Netteté: Enhances edges and fine detail in the image.
Netteté et bruit: Sharpness map (local contrast) and an estimate of the image noise level.
Nettoyer le pinceau après chaque trait: Cleans the brush of picked-up colors at the end of each stroke.
Nom: Name the item is saved under in the library.
Nom de base: Name that replaces {nom} in file names; empty uses the project name.
Nom de l'encre: Name of the spot color ink, used in the layer name.
Nom du fichier sous chaque image: Writes the file name under each thumbnail.
Nom du préréglage: Name under which the current scene will appear in the preset list.
Nombre de poils: Number of bristles that leave grooves in the paint.
Normale: Normal map convention: DirectX (Y-, Unreal) or OpenGL (Y+, Unity, Blender, Godot).
Normale (espace tangent): Bakes a tangent-space normal map carrying the high-poly detail (requires a high-poly mesh).
Normale monde: Bakes a world-space normal map, useful for orientation-based masks (top, sides).
Nouveau (graphe): Creates a new node-based brush in the Effect Editor.
Nouveau calque: Adds an empty pixel layer above the active layer (Ctrl+Shift+N).
Nouveau calque HLSL personnalisé: Adds an adjustment layer whose HLSL shader you write yourself.
Nouveau calque de remplissage: Adds a generated layer (color, gradient, pattern, noise...), masked by the selection if there is one.
Nouveau calque de réglage: Adds a non-destructive adjustment layer (levels, curves, hue...) that affects the layers below.
Nouveau calque de réglage « Effet visuel: Adds an empty adjustment layer to build with nodes in this editor.
Nouveau calque « Effet visuel » (graphe): Adds an adjustment layer whose effect is built with nodes in the Effect Editor.
Nouveau document: Opens the generated image in a new document; otherwise it is added as a layer.
Nouveau document Ctrl+N: Creates a new blank document, choosing its size and mode (Ctrl+N).
Nouveau document|Créer: Creates the new document with these settings or the chosen template.
Nouveau document|Hauteur: Height of the new document, in pixels.
Nouveau document|Mode: Working mode of the document: classic layers or node graph (advanced).
Nouveau document|Préréglage: Fills in the width and height with a common size (screen, paper format, icon...).
Nouveau nœud (non relié): Adds this effect as a new, unconnected node in the graph.
Nouveau pinceau (code): Creates a new HLSL brush from a template.
Nouveau plan de travail: Adds an artboard: the first takes over the canvas, the next ones are added to the right.
Nouveau projet Paint 3D: Creates a 3D texturing project on a sphere, cube, plane or your own model.
Nouveau projet Paint 3D|Créer: Creates the Paint 3D project with the chosen model, resolution and channels.
Nouveau projet Paint 3D|Fichier: Uses your own 3D model loaded from a file.
Nouveau projet Paint 3D|Résolution: Texture size of each project channel, in pixels.
Nouveau vide (graphe): Starts a new, empty node-based item.
Creates a new blank document or one from a template (Ctrl+N).
Nouvel objet par copie: Duplicates the layer with independent contents, unlike Duplicate which shares them.
Nouvelle: Creates a comp from the current state of the layers.
Nouvelle fenêtre: Opens an extra application window, for example for a second screen.
Nuancier: Saved colors: click one to make it the foreground color, load .aco, .ase or .gpl swatch files.
Loads a Photoshop, Adobe Swatch Exchange or GIMP swatch file into the Swatches panel.
Négatif: Negative prompt: what the AI should avoid in the recreated area.
Nœud seul: Adds this effect as a new, unconnected node in the graph.
Objets: Render scene objects: the model, floor, backdrop, primitives and imported models.
Objets dynamiques: Create, edit, import and rasterize smart objects.
Obscurcissement: How much the corrected pupil is darkened.
Occlusion ambiante: Bakes an ambient occlusion map: crevices and areas hidden from light get darker.
Ombre: Opacity of the main light's shadows: 0 = no shadow, 1 = full shadows.
Ombre au sol: Main light shadow and contact shadow on an invisible floor under the model (Quality render).
Opacité: Opacity: from transparent (0) to fully opaque (1 or 100).
Opacité aléatoire: Random opacity variation of each dab.
Opacité de l'arrêt: Opacity of the selected color stop in the gradient (0: transparent, 1: opaque).
Options: Settings of the active tool: size, hardness, tolerance, mode, and so on.
Options de fusion (Blend If): Hides parts of the layer based on the brightness or a channel of the layer itself or the underlying layer.
Options|Angle: Rotation angle of the transform, in degrees.
Options|Défaut: Reverts to the brush's default image.
Options|Inverser: Reverses the direction of the gradient.
Options|Lissage: Steadies the stroke by filtering hand jitter: higher values give smoother but lagging strokes.
Options|Mode: Mode of the active tool: component replaced, Liquify distortion type, or saturate / desaturate for the Sponge.
Options|Opacité: Maximum opacity of the paint or gradient applied by the tool.
Options|Orientation: Horizontal direction of the custom gravity, in degrees.
Options|Position: Location of the selected stop along the gradient, from 0 (start) to 1 (end).
Options|Préréglage: Replaces the gradient with a predefined one (foreground to background, spectrum...).
Options|Réinitialiser: Resets the warp grid to its initial shape.
Options|Style: Gradient shape: linear, radial, angle, reflected or diamond.
Options|Taille: Active tool diameter in pixels (brush, healing, quick selection) or text size; [ and ] change it.
Options|Tolérance: Color difference accepted from the clicked or sampled pixel: higher values include more pixels.
Options|Type: Shape drawn by the tool: rectangle, ellipse, line, polygon, star or custom shape.
Options|Épaisseur: Stroke width of the shape being drawn, in pixels.
Opération: Operation run by the step: rotation or flip, or the AI bridge operation to call.
Ordre: Position of this pin among the node's inputs or outputs.
Orthographique: Parallel projection with no perspective: sizes do not change with distance.
Outil Peinture liquide: Activates the Liquid Paint tool: simulated drips under gravity, across every material channel.
Outil Projection: Activates the Projection tool to apply the chosen image as a decal on the model.
Outil Recadrage: Activates the Crop tool to draw the frame to keep (C).
Outils: Toolbox: choose the painting, selection or retouching tool to use.
Ouverture (f/): Aperture used for the shot; it mainly affects vignetting correction.
Opens the Photo RAW window to adjust this development with its full preview.
Ouvrir en grand: Opens a panel in its own window, to enlarge it or move it to another screen.
Ouvrir le dossier: Opens the folder for lensfun database files in Explorer.
Ouvrir le dossier de mes modèles: Opens the folder that holds your own templates in File Explorer.
Ouvrir le dossier des exemples: Opens the examples folder in Windows Explorer.
Ouvrir le dossier utilisateur: Opens your personal plugin folder in Explorer (creating it if needed).
Ouvrir les fichiers récents: Reopens one of the recently opened files.
Loads HLSL code from a file (.hlsl, .fx, .slang, .txt).
Opens an image or a document in a new tab (Ctrl+O).
Ouvrir... Ctrl+O: Opens an image or a Shaderixel document (Ctrl+O).
Page de téléchargement: Opens the lensfun database page in your browser to download lens profiles.
Palette de nœuds: List of nodes to drag into the graph, with search by name.
Shows the Image Analysis panel (histogram, scopes, statistics).
Panneaux: Shows or hides each panel of the interface.
Panorama: Masks that join overlapping images into a seamless panorama.
Paramètres avancés (JSON): Shows and edits all the raw parameters of the step as JSON.
Paramètres de la grille: Sets the grid spacing and subdivisions.
Rotates the whole image by any angle entered in a dialog.
Picks the image folder by selecting one of its files.
Partage glissant: Comparison with a draggable divider: before on one side, after on the other.
Particules / s: Number of particles emitted per second while the mouse button is held.
Partie: Part of the model whose material you edit (one material per part).
Partir de l'image actuelle (img2img): Generates from the active document image instead of starting from scratch.
Pas (px): Spacing of the main grid lines, in pixels.
PassLive (entrée en direct): Makes the tool's input live again for editing; upstream nodes are no longer frozen.
Passer en Path tracing: Switches the 3D view to path tracing to adjust samples, bounces and depth of field.
Passer en déformation (grille): Switches the transform to a 4 x 4 warp grid whose points move freely.
Passer en mode nodal: Converts the document into a node graph, editable in the Graph panel.
Peindre des retouches: Paints corrections over the smart mask; they are kept when it is regenerated.
Peindre le masque: Brush strokes paint the layer mask instead of its pixels (white: visible, black: hidden).
Personnalisé: Custom snapping step; entering one turns snapping on to that grid.
Writes your own blend mode in HLSL code, starting from a template.
Perspective: Perspective view: distant objects look smaller (otherwise orthographic view).
Opens Photo RAW development: white balance, exposure, curves, lens (Ctrl+Shift+A).
Photo RAW|Recharger: Reloads the lensfun lens profile database from disk.
Photo RAW|Réinitialiser: Resets all Photo RAW settings to their defaults.
Photo RAW|Saturation: Adjusts the saturation of each color range separately.
Photo RAW|Teinte: Shifts the hue of each color range (reds, oranges, yellows...).
Stitches several overlapping photos into a panorama.
Pinceaux: Brush library: choose a tip, tweak it, or create your own in code or as a graph.
Imports the brush tips of a Photoshop .abr file.
Pinceaux|Défaut: Reverts to the brush's default image.
Pivot: Point the layer rotates and scales around, relative to its size (0.5, 0.5: center). The layer stays in place.
Pixel: Values of the pixel under the mouse and fixed color sampler points on the image.
Pixelliser: Converts the smart object into a regular pixel layer.
Pixelliser le calque: Converts the text or shape layer into pixels you can paint on.
Pixels contigus: Only affects pixels connected to the clicked point; unchecked, every similar color in the image.
Pixels du calque actif: Selects the non-transparent pixels of the active layer.
Placer comme calque (objet dynamique): Places the image as an embedded smart object that can be transformed without quality loss.
Placer lié au fichier: Places the image as a linked smart object that follows changes to the original file.
Placer sur le tracé actif: Makes the text follow the active path.
Plafond: Upside-down surface: the paint drips and falls.
Plage: Tones affected by the tool: shadows, midtones or highlights.
Plage de couleurs: Selects pixels close to sampled colors or to a range (reds, highlights, skin tones...).
Selects pixels by sampled colors or by a tonal range.
Plage de couleurs|Inverser: Selects everything except the chosen color range.
Plage de couleurs|Mode: How the chosen range combines with the existing selection: new, add, subtract or intersect.
Plage de couleurs|Sélection: Colors to select: colors sampled in the image or a preset range (reds, highlights, skin tones...).
Plan: Creates the project on a flat plane.
Planche contact: Lays out the images of a folder in a grid on one or more pages.
Creates a page of thumbnails from the images in a folder.
Planche contact|Créer: Builds the contact sheet from the folder's images.
Planche contact|Hauteur (px): Height of each contact sheet page, in pixels.
Planche contact|Largeur (px): Width of each contact sheet page, in pixels.
Planche contact|Marge (px): Empty space around the edge of each page, in pixels.
Planche contact|Taille: Font size of the file names, in pixels.
Plugins: Commands and windows added by plugins, and the plugin manager.
Plugins|Créer: Creates a skeleton for a new plugin of the chosen kind, ready to edit.
Plugins|Recharger: Unloads and reloads the plugin DLL, for example after rebuilding it.
Point d'accès: Address of the service to call (API or ComfyUI server URL).
Police: Text typeface, chosen from the installed fonts.
Portée de l'occlusion: Maximum distance at which geometry occludes a point, as a percentage of the model size.
Poser au sol: Moves the object up or down so its lowest point rests on the floor.
Position: Where the stroke sits relative to the selection edge: inside, centered or outside.
Position (objets dynamiques): The comp stores and restores the position and transform of smart objects.
Position (px): Position in document pixels (X, Y); drag or type a value.
Pourcentage: New size as a percentage of the current size.
Prendre un instantané (avant): Stores the current render as the "before" state to compare with later edits.
Pression -> flux: Pen pressure controls the amount of paint laid down.
Pression -> taille: Pen pressure controls the brush size.
Profil d'objectif (lensfun): Picks the camera and lens from the lensfun database to correct or simulate distortion, vignetting and chromatic aberration.
Projection: How images are aligned: automatic perspective or translation only.
Prompt négatif: What the generated image should avoid.
Propriétés: Settings of the selected item: layer, mask, filter, text, shape or node.
Propriétés|Décalage: Starting position of the text along the path, in pixels.
Propriétés|Fond: Fills the inside of the shape with the chosen color.
Propriétés|Mettre à jour: Reloads the smart object's linked file to pick up its latest changes.
Propriétés|Mode: Blend mode: how this layer or node mixes with what lies beneath it.
Propriétés|Nom: Name of the layer, node or variable.
Propriétés|Opacité: Opacity of the layer or node, as a percentage.
Propriétés|Position: Position of the text in the document, in pixels (X, Y).
Propriétés|Préréglage: Sets the artboard to a common size (screen, paper format, icon...).
Propriétés|Rayon: Corner radius of the rectangle, in pixels.
Propriétés|Recharger: Reloads the lensfun lens profile database from disk.
Propriétés|Réinitialiser: Resets the Blend If ranges to their defaults (no limits).
Propriétés|Taille: Font size of the text layer, in pixels.
Propriétés|Type: Type of the shape layer or of the function (subgraph or tool).
Propriétés|Verrouillé: Locks the layer to prevent accidental edits.
Propriétés|Épaisseur: Stroke width of the shape layer's outline, in pixels.
Précision: Document color depth: 16-bit float (lighter) or 32-bit float (more precise).
Prémultiplié: The effect works on alpha-premultiplied colors, avoiding fringes on transparent edges.
Préréglage: Applies a set of predefined settings to this section (lighting, color grading...).
Python : une commande de menu: Python plugin that adds a command to the Plugins menu.
Python : une fenêtre: Python plugin that adds a window to the interface.
Qualité: JPEG compression quality: higher gives a more faithful image but a larger file.
Rayon (px): Radius of the selection operation, in pixels.
Rayon d'analyse (px): Size of the area examined around each pixel to measure sharpness.
Rayon des coins: Rectangle corner rounding, in pixels (0: sharp corners).
Rayons d'occlusion: Number of rays cast per texel for occlusion: more rays mean less noise but a slower bake.
Rebonds: Number of light bounces: more bounces give more accurate indirect light and glass, but render slower.
Recadrage en perspective: Crops by placing four corners on a plane (facade, document); the image is straightened into a rectangle.
Recadrer (Entrée): Crops the image to the drawn frame (Enter).
Recadrer selon la sélection: Crops the image to the bounding box of the active selection.
Recherche exhaustive (lent): Tries every position for tighter packing, at the cost of much longer computation.
Rechercher de nouveaux plugins: Rescans the plugin folders and loads plugins added since startup.
Recréer les sous-dossiers: Recreates the source subfolder tree in the output folder.
Redresser (Entrée): Applies the perspective crop and straightens the plane into a rectangle (Enter).
Redresser / corriger la perspective: Enables geometry correction: rotation, straightening verticals and perspective.
Redresser l'image: Rotates the image so the measured line becomes horizontal or vertical.
Redresser les horizontales: Makes the planes' nearly horizontal edges exactly horizontal.
Redresser les verticales: Makes the planes' nearly vertical edges exactly vertical.
Relancer: Clears the error and restarts the plugin panel's program.
Relatif (ajouter à la taille): The values are added to the current canvas size instead of replacing it.
Relief (épaisseur): Strength of the relief created by paint thickness on the model (height and normal).
Relief depuis l'image: Derives relief (height) from the projected image's brightness.
Remplacer: Overwrites this saved view with the current angle, framing and focal length.
Replaces the smart object's image with another file, keeping its transforms.
Remplacer par le premier plan: Replaces this swatch's color with the foreground color.
Remplir: Fills the inside of the active path with the foreground color on the active layer.
Remplir avec la couleur de premier plan: Fills the selection (or layer) with the foreground color (Alt+Backspace).
Remplir avec le matériau du pinceau: Fills each checked channel of the layer with the brush value, inside the selection if there is one.
Remplir d'après le contenu (Maj+F5): Fills the selection with pixels synthesized from the surrounding image (Shift+F5).
Remplir tout: Fills the mask with white: the material covers the whole texture.
Remplissage: New fill layer: color, gradient, pattern or generator, with a mask.
Rendu: Photorealistic path-traced render of the 3D scene.
Reporter la peinture existante sur les n: Transfers the textures already painted onto the new unwrap when applying.
Repères: Shows or hides guides; drag from a ruler to create one (Ctrl+;).
Ressources: Browses your folders of images, models and files; drag them onto the canvas, layers or graph.
Retirer: Removes the style from the selected text or paragraphs (all text when nothing is selected).
Retirer la transformation: Removes the layer's non-destructive Transform filter, restoring its original placement.
Retirer tous les points: Removes all the color sampler points placed on the image.
Retirer toutes les épingles: Removes every pin and returns the image to its original shape.
Retour au calque actif: Leaves the final output and shows the active layer's properties again.
Retour à l'édition: Closes the library and returns to the item being edited.
Retrait 1re ligne: Indent of the paragraph's first line; a negative value makes a hanging indent.
Retrait gauche: Indent of the whole paragraph from the left edge, in pixels.
Revenir au mode Normal: Removes the effect blend and sets the layer back to the Normal blend mode.
Revenir aux UV précédentes: Restores the UVs from before the last applied unwrap.
Revenir à l'original: Discards your changes and reverts to the library brush.
Rogner au document: Converts the smart object into a pixel layer limited to the document; anything outside is discarded.
Rogner les bords transparents: Removes fully transparent borders around the exported image.
Trims transparent or solid-color borders around the image.
Rond (dureté): Simple round tip whose edge depends on hardness.
Ronde (standard): Classic round tip, with no special shape or texture.
Rondeur: Favors compact, rounded islands over elongated ones.
Rotation (°): Layer rotation angle around its pivot, in degrees.
Rotation de l'image: Rotates or flips the whole canvas, including all layers.
Rotation des îlots: Allows islands to be rotated to fill the atlas better.
Rugosité: 0 = smooth surface with sharp reflections, 1 = matte surface with diffuse reflections.
Rugosité depuis l'image: Derives roughness from the projected image's brightness, between the min and max values.
Rugosité du vernis: Sharpness of the clear coat's reflections: 0 = mirror, 1 = satin.
Règles: Shows or hides the rulers along the top and left of the canvas (Ctrl+R).
Réglage: New adjustment layer: non-destructively changes the layers below it.
Réglages du rendu: Compute device, samples, bounces, resolution and tone mapping of the render.
Sets the graphics and system memory reserved for undo steps.
Réinitialiser la courbe: Resets the channel curve to a straight line (no change).
Réinitialiser la disposition: Puts the panels back in their default places.
Réinitialiser la grille: Resets the warp grid flat, to the original frame.
Réinitialiser les réglages: Removes the image adjustments, blur and sharpening applied to the layer.
Répartir les centres horizontalement: Evenly spaces the horizontal centers of the chosen layers (three layers or more).
Résultat: Where to put the result: a new selection, a new layer or a new document.
Rééchantillonnage: Pixel interpolation method: nearest neighbor (pixel art), bilinear or bicubic (smoother).
SDK et exemples: Opens the plugin SDK folder: headers, documentation and examples to start from.
Scinder horizontalement: Splits the selected plane into two stacked planes.
Scinder verticalement: Splits the selected plane into two side-by-side planes.
Scène (fichiers, préréglages): Loads, saves and applies complete render scenes or lighting presets.
Scène de rendu: Objects, lights, environment, camera and settings for the path-traced render.
Scène de rendu|Appliquer: What the scene preset replaces: the whole scene, only lighting and environment, or adds its objects to the current scene.
Scène de rendu|Dupliquer: Duplicates the selected scene object, slightly offset.
Scène de rendu|Format: Picks a preset render resolution (HD, 4K, square, portrait...).
Scène de rendu|Hauteur: Height of the rendered image, in pixels.
Scène de rendu|Inclinaison: Vertical tilt of the light, in degrees.
Scène de rendu|Intensité: Strength of the selected light, or of the HDRI environment lighting.
Scène de rendu|Nom: Name of the selected object or light.
Scène de rendu|Orientation: Horizontal direction of the light, in degrees.
Scène de rendu|Ouverture: Cone angle of the spot light, in degrees.
Scène de rendu|Position: Position of the selected object or light in the scene (X, Y, Z).
Scène de rendu|Préréglage: Applies a preset to this section: material, scene or color grading depending on where it sits.
Scène de rendu|Rotation: Rotation in degrees: of the object on its axes, or of the HDRI environment around the scene.
Scène de rendu|Supprimer: Removes the selected object or light from the scene.
Scène de rendu|Type: Light type: point, spot, area or sun.
Scène de rendu|Échelle: Size of the selected object (1 = original size).
Sec: Dry preset: the brush mostly lays down its own color.
Segments: Number of repetitions around the center for radial or mandala symmetry.
Seuil du bloom: Brightness above which an area produces bloom.
Si le fichier existe: What to do when the output file already exists: replace it, skip the image or add a number to the name.
Sol (ombres portées): Adds an invisible floor under the model that catches its cast shadows.
Soleil (avec HDRI): Strength of the directional light added on top of the HDRI lighting.
Solidité: Simulated on-screen ink opacity: 0 transparent, 1 fully covering.
Sortir du dossier: Moves the selected layer out of its folder.
Source: Document the applied image comes from (same size as the active document).
Spectre: Frequency spectrum of the luminance (2D FFT): fine detail, repeating patterns and noise.
Sphère: Creates the project on a sphere.
Statistiques: Minimum, maximum, mean, median and standard deviation of each channel.
Style de caractère: Character style applied by default to text in this paragraph.
Styles de texte: Reusable character and paragraph styles applied to the selected text.
Styles de texte|Couleur: Color applied by this style when the box on the left is checked.
Styles de texte|Nouveau: Creates a new style to apply to text.
Styles de texte|Taille: Text size set by the style; at the minimum, the layer's own size is kept.
Subdivisions: Number of subdivisions between two main grid lines.
Suffixe: Text appended to the file name for this size (for example @2x).
Suit la caméra: Keeps the light's direction relative to the camera as you orbit the model.
Suivre le trait: The tip rotates to follow the stroke direction.
Supprimer ce préréglage: Permanently deletes this user preset from disk.
Supprimer cette forme: Removes this custom shape from the library.
Supprimer l'instantané: Deletes the "before" snapshot and stops the comparison.
Supprimer la variable: Removes this variable from the graph; nodes that get or set it lose their target.
Supprimer le commentaire: Deletes this comment from the graph; the nodes it frames stay.
Supprimer le commentaire (garde les nœud: Removes the comment frame without deleting the nodes inside it.
Supprimer le matériau: Deletes this material and its channel layers.
Supprimer le modèle: Deletes the selected personal template (asks for confirmation).
Supprimer le nœud: Deletes the selected node and its links.
Supprimer le plan: Deletes the selected plane (at least one must remain).
Supprimer le style: Deletes this style; text that used it goes back to the layer's formatting.
Symétrie horizontale de la zone de trava: Flips the whole image left to right, like a mirror.
Symétrie verticale de la zone de travail: Flips the whole image upside down.
Sélection: Select menu: select all, deselect, inverse, modify or transform the selection.
Sélectionner et masquer: Refines the selection edge (hair, fur, foliage) and outputs it as a selection or mask.
Refines the selection edge: hair, fur, foliage (Alt+Ctrl+R).
Sélectionner et masquer|Affichage: How the mask is shown while editing: red overlay, black and white, on black or white...
Sélectionner et masquer|Contraste: Hardens the edge transition: higher values make the selection edge crisper.
Sélectionner et masquer|Lissage: Smooths out irregularities in the selection outline, in pixels.
Sélectionner les calques liés: Selects all layers linked to the active layer.
Sélectionner ses pixels: Selects the active trim's rectangle on the image.
Séparation de fréquences: Splits the layer into a color and tone layer (low frequencies) and a detail layer (high frequencies) for retouching.
Tableau: Turns this value into a list of items of the same type instead of a single value.
Taille aléatoire: Random size variation of each dab.
Taille d'un motif: Size of one mosaic tile, relative to the plane.
Resamples the whole image to new dimensions (Ctrl+Alt+I).
Taille de la pupille: Size of the corrected area around the click, in pixels.
Taille de la vue: Renders at the current viewport size; when off, pick a fixed resolution.
Enlarges or shrinks the canvas without resampling the image, around an anchor point (Ctrl+Alt+C).
Taille des gouttes: Size of the trail left by each particle, as a percentage of the model size.
Tel quel: Reverts to the white balance recorded by the camera (temperature and tint at zero).
Température: Warms (toward orange) or cools (toward blue) the colors.
Texture: Index of the brush texture this node reads (1 to 4).
Titre: Title shown on the code node.
Tolérance: Color difference accepted from the foreground color: higher values select more pixels.
Tous les calques: Detects colors on the composite of all visible layers, not just the active layer.
Tous les canaux: Applies the filter to every channel of the material.
Toutes les images à cette durée: Applies this duration to every frame of the animation.
Tracés: The document's vector paths drawn with the Pen: turn into a selection, fill or stroke.
Tracés|Nouveau: Starts a new path with the Pen tool.
Tracés|Sélection: Converts the active path to a selection; Shift adds, Alt subtracts.
Traitement par lots: Applies a chain of actions to a folder of images or to the open documents, then saves the results.
Opens Batch Processing: applies one or more actions to a whole folder of images or to the open documents.
Traitement par lots|Documents ouverts: Processes the open documents; they are modified (undoable through History) and stay open.
Traitement par lots|Format: Format of the images saved after processing; "None" only writes through the actions' Export steps.
Traiter un dossier de RAW avec ces régla: Creates an action with these settings and opens batch processing to apply it to a folder of RAW photos.
Tramage: Adds subtle noise to the gradient to prevent banding in smooth transitions.
Transformation (Ctrl+T): Moves, scales or rotates the smart object without quality loss (Ctrl+T).
Transformation manuelle: Moves, scales and rotates the layer or selection with handles (Ctrl+T).
Transformer la sélection: Moves, scales or rotates the selection outline without changing the pixels.
Transition: Softness of the transition between selected and unselected areas.
Transparence: Keeps transparency in the exported file; otherwise it is filled with the background color.
Traverser: The group isn't flattened first: its layers blend directly with the layers below.
Trim sheet: Splits a texture into reusable strips (trims) for 3D modeling, with preview and export.
Trim sheet|Décalage: Shifts the tiling preview to check the trim's seams.
Trim sheet|Marge (px): Space between trim sheet strips, in pixels.
Trim sheet|Modèle: Preset layout of the trim sheet strips.
Très humide: Very wet preset: the brush mostly smears the canvas colors.
Turntable: Exports a full rotation of the model as an MP4 video, animated GIF or PNG image sequence.
Turntable|Taille: Dimensions of the turntable video, in pixels.
UV automatiques (xatlas): Computes a new UV unwrap of the model with xatlas, previewed before applying.
UV automatiques (xatlas)|Préréglage: Unwrap settings preset: balanced, fewer islands, low distortion, hard surface or repack only.
UV automatiques (xatlas)|Résolution: Target texture size for island packing; it sets padding and placement precision.
Unités: Enters dimensions as a percentage or in pixels.
Valeur: Constant value output by this node.
Valeurs par défaut: Resets the filter settings of this step to their defaults.
Variable: Graph variable read or written by this node.
Variable de la clé: Name of the environment variable holding the API key; Shaderixel never stores the key.
Variation d'angle: Randomly varies the tip angle on each dab.
Variation de flux: Randomly varies the amount of paint laid down on each dab.
Variation de taille: Randomly varies the tip size on each dab.
Variations: Number of versions generated; each one lands in its own layer so you can pick the best.
Vectorscope: Vectorscope: hue (angle) and saturation (distance from center) of pixels, with the skin tone line.
Vers: Where the result goes: selection, mask on the active layer, or a new layer with a mask.
Verticale: Applies the warp vertically instead of horizontally.
Vider: Fills the mask with black: the material no longer shows anywhere.
Vidéo MP4: Saves the turn as an MP4 video.
Vignetage: Corrects the corner darkening caused by the lens.
Vignettage: Darkens the corners of the image.
Viser le modèle: Points the selected light at the center of the model.
Visibilité: The comp stores and restores which layers are visible or hidden.
Visible: Shows or hides the layer in the image.
Visible en fond: Shows the HDRI behind the scene; when off, it lights the scene without being seen.
Vitesse du temps: Speeds up or slows down the drip simulation: above 1, paint flows and dries faster.
Voir le HLSL généré: Shows the HLSL code generated from the graph.
Voir le calque: Goes back to previewing the layer instead of the selected node.
Voir le code: Shows the HLSL code of this library effect.
Voir le graphe: Shows this library item's node graph instead of its code.
Vue 3D: Displays and paints the 3D model, with lighting, environment and render settings.
Vue 3D|Direction: Light direction around the model, in degrees.
Vue 3D|Hauteur: Light elevation above the horizon, in degrees.
Vue 3D|Intensité: Strength of the light in the 3D view.
Vue 3D|Saturation: Color saturation of the render: 0 is grayscale, 1 unchanged, higher is more vivid.
Vue 3D|Teinte: Shifts the render's color balance between green and magenta.
Waveform: Waveform: pixel levels according to their horizontal position in the image.
Workflow: ComfyUI workflow file (.json) used for AI upscaling.
Workflow (API): ComfyUI workflow JSON file exported in API format; empty uses the built-in graph.
Zone de netteté: Automatically selects the in-focus parts of the photo based on local detail.
Zoom: Preview zoom level; double-click the image to toggle between actual size and fit.
\\xE2\\x86\\x91: Goes up to the parent folder.
rien: Fills the mask with black: the material no longer shows anywhere.
{nom}_{l}x{h}: Name pattern: original name followed by the final width and height (photo_1024x768).
{nom}_{n3}: Name pattern: original name followed by a 3-digit number (photo_001).
À plat: Flat surface: the paint spreads without running.
À propos de Shaderixel: Shows Shaderixel's version, rendering backend and build date.
Échantillonner tous les calques: Samples the composite of all visible layers, not just the active layer.
Échantillons: Number of accumulated passes: more passes give a cleaner, less noisy image.
Échantillons / image: Path-tracing samples computed per frame: more samples mean less noise but slower export.
Échelle des irrégularités: Size of the flow variations: small for fine detail, large for broad shapes.
Échelle du motif: Scales the painted pattern up or down.
Écran 1920 x 1080: Page sized for a Full HD screen (1920 x 1080 px).
Éditer (code / graphe): Opens the effect in the effect editor to change its code or graph.
Éditer en graphe (sur le calque actif): Applies this blend mode to the active layer as a graph you can edit in the visual editor.
Éditer l'original: Opens the library item itself for editing.
Éditer la fusion (code / graphe): Opens the blend mode in the effect editor to change its code or graph.
Éditer le graphe: Opens the active layer's blend graph in the Effect Editor.
Éditeur d'actions: Action Editor: create, edit, reorder and test the steps of your actions, or start from the built-in actions.
Éditeur d'actions|Couleur: Fill color stored in the step.
Éditeur d'actions|Effet: Filter applied by this step; type to search the effect library.
Saves all your actions to a file to share or back them up.
Éditeur d'actions|Format: File format exported by this step: PNG, JPG, TGA, BMP, PSD, SXL or 16-bit TIFF.
Éditeur d'actions|Mode: Step mode: how the new size is computed (resize) or the blend mode given to the layer.
Éditeur d'actions|Opacité: Opacity given to the layer by this step, if the box on the left is checked.
Éditeur d'actions|Sélection: What the step does to the selection: select all, deselect or inverse.
Éditeur d'actions|Visible: Visibility given to the layer by this step, if the box on the left is checked.
Éditeur d'effets: Creates and edits effects, blend modes and brushes as nodes or HLSL code, with previews.
Éditeur d'effets|Catégorie: Category the item is filed under in the library and menus.
Éditeur d'effets|Couleur: Value of the constant color node (HDR, floating-point values).
Éditeur d'effets|Dispersion: Randomly offsets each dab around the stroke, in diameters.
Éditeur d'effets|Défaut: Default value of the parameter, used while nothing is connected; the small button resets to the default.
Éditeur d'effets|Dégrouper: Replaces the function with the nodes it contains, directly in the graph.
Éditeur d'effets|Effet: Edits the graph of the layer's effect (rather than its blend mode).
Éditeur d'effets|Nom: Name of the selected effect, parameter or function.
Éditeur d'effets|Position: Location of the selected stop along the ramp, from 0 (left) to 1 (right).
Éditeur d'effets|Type: Value type of the pin (number, vector, color, texture...).
Éditeur d'effets|Verrouillé: Prevents this item of your library from being overwritten by a save.
Opens the Action Editor to view, edit and reorder action steps.
Édition: Edit menu: undo, clipboard, fill, stroke, patterns and transforms.
Épaisseur (px): Width of the stroke drawn around the selection, in pixels.
Épreuvage: Simulates on screen how the image will look on another device (CMYK printer...) and sets the proof profile.
Étapes: Number of sampling steps: more steps give a more refined image but take longer.
Étendue du bloom: Size of the bloom glow around bright areas.
Événement: Function event to run; defaults to the function's first event.
